purpose: define an outcome-independent stopping rule for world-island expansion before the final Izu zoom

large_island_master_scope.source: Global Islands v3 / WCMC-USGS-derived historical artifact in zuizui0223/island
large_island_master_scope.unit_of_review: deduplicated ecological island system, not polygon

large_island_saturation_condition.interpretation: two consecutive geography-first tranches add no materially new response/process/falsification state and no full contract

mandatory_before_izu: complete at least one geography-independent small-island supplement below the 20 km2 master threshold
perform a separate manuscript-value review rather than automatically promoting searched systems
preserve the frozen 25-entry formal identifiability denominator unless a separately preregistered re-audit is opened
document whether the historical turnover-coordinate bottleneck persists
izu_transition_rule: Izu may become the final mechanistic-resolution zoom only after the large-island saturation condition is met and the small-island supplement has been reviewed.
anti_cherry_picking_rule: A tranche cannot be declared saturated by dropping systems after their literature outcomes are known.
